text: A muscular male figure with a broad build, tanned skin, and long blonde hair in a single braid down his back. His face is angular with intense eyes and a grimace. He wears a dark red loincloth with a gold circular belt buckle and white tusks as adornments. Kneeling low, he grips a spear with both hands, poised to thrust forward. Behind him, other figures lie motionless on the ground in a dimly lit, rocky landscape.
